intro: I study [Mathematics and Business Administration](yellow) at the University of Waterloo, with a focus on [mathematical optimization](blue), combinatorics, finance, and computer science.

I've built and shipped [AI/automation tools in production](orange) — at Othership I built RAG and GPT-based systems that processed [150K+ accounts](green) and saved $12K+ annually. I've also done contract automation work for startups like Jaybird Studios and Lagree West, and led product development at a TKS × Interac innovation sprint, presenting a [Gen-Z financial coaching app](yellow) to Interac's innovation team.
Outside of that, I enjoy [math competitions](blue), case studies, and exploring problems at the intersection of [quantitative reasoning](orange) and real-world impact.
